title: Render Report
description: Output report produced by the Composer agent after rendering.

reel_id.description: Which reel produced this output, for pipelines that render more than one per run. Without it 'this output's plan entry' has no typed referent — both joins that exist today go through metadata, which is untyped. Absent for every single-output pipeline, which is what optional means.

caption_animation.description: The caption motion that actually rendered, as reported by the burn tool rather than copied from the plan. This is the one class of output fact ffprobe cannot recover: motion is burned into pixels with no container trace, so it is the documented exception to composing every output field from a probe.

caption_degraded.description: True when the caption pass fell back to a static SRT burn. Separates a downgrade from a defect; a warnings[] string cannot be joined back to a reel.

render_grammar.description: Which renderer family was used for this render

decision_log_ref.description: Path to the project's cumulative decision log

final_review_ref.description: Path or inline reference to the final_review artifact produced by post-render self-review. Provides durable audit linkage between the render output and its quality inspection.
